title: Rain Chain 3.8 m, 12 Cups – See the Water Run Down
seo_title: Rain Chain 3.8 m, 12 Cups – See the Water Run
seo_description: Rain chain in copper-colored metal, 3.8 m long with 12 cups. You see the water run cup by cup instead of disappearing into a pipe.
descriptionHtml:
The downpipe makes the rain invisible

The water disappears straight down a gray pipe without you seeing or hearing any of it. The corner by the downpipe becomes the one spot in the garden that rarely comes to life when the rain arrives.

A chain with 12 cups instead of a pipe

The rain chain is 3.8 meters long with 12 metal cups, copper-colored, and links with a grid pattern. The water follows cup by cup all the way down instead of disappearing into a pipe.

Features

  • 12 cups along the whole chain – you can follow the rainwater with your eyes all the way down.
  • Copper-colored metal – shows as a detail on the facade instead of being hidden like a gray pipe.
  • 3.8 meters long – a full chain, not a short piece that runs out halfway.
  • Grid-patterned links – each cup hangs from a link with a distinct pattern, not a smooth wire.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

No details about the cups' diameter or about mounting brackets are included – only the chain with cups is confirmed.
